🎉 Welcome to GDG on Campus University of Bristol!

We’re a student-run community for anyone curious about technology and the ideas it can bring to life. Whether you’re writing your first line of code, building a project or simply wondering where to start, you’re welcome here. No prior experience is needed.

Our vision

We want to make it easier for students at Bristol to learn together, meet people and use technology to make a difference. Our community is a space to ask questions, share ideas and find support as you turn those ideas into real projects.

Now in our fourth year, we’re excited to keep building a community that future students can grow.

💡 What’s in store?

  • Hands-on workshops: Try new technologies and build practical skills with support from others.

  • Speaker sessions: Hear about developer careers, internships, applications and interviews from people with firsthand experience.

  • Technical talks: Explore topics such as TensorFlow, Android development and Go.

  • Social events: Meet students who share your interests, make friends and find potential project partners.

Whether you’re interested in software development, tech and business, or an idea that could help your community, there’s a place for you at GDG on Campus.

🤝 Collaborate with us

We’d love to hear from GDG leads at other universities, potential speakers and anyone interested in hosting an event or working with our community.

📲 Join and stay in touch

Click the “Join” button on this page to stay updated on upcoming events. You may need to create a GDG profile first, then return to this page to join.

Email: gdscbristol@gmail.com
Instagram: @gdscbristol

Let’s learn, build and grow together! 🙌

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

🔥Join us at Google Developer Group Ahlen in NRW, Germany, and be part of a dynamic community of tech enthusiasts, lifelong learners, and forward-thinking developers. 

  • 🌍 Ahlen is a city that distinctively blends rich history with a forward-thinking spirit.

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders.

  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.
  • Vibrant Networking Opportunities: Connect with hundreds of passionate developers from your local community and potentially beyond. Share knowledge, discuss challenges, collaborate on ideas, and build valuable professional connections.

No matter where you are in your coding journey—whether you're a beginner exploring your first programming language or a seasoned developer tackling complex challenges—our community is here to support, inspire, and grow with you. 💡

Let’s learn, share, and create the future of technology together! 🚀

On ne veut pas seulement créer de la tech, on veut créer un futur qui a du sens.

Le monde change à une vitesse folle, et on est convaincus que la seule façon de protéger notre planète et nos systèmes, c'est de donner les moyens d'agir à ceux qui les construisent. En soutenant nos projets, tu ne fais pas qu'un simple "don" : tu investis dans les esprits qui résoudront les défis de demain.

Qu’il s’agisse d’offrir leurs premiers kits de dev à des étudiants passionnés ou de lancer des bootcamps pour transformer des idées folles en solutions locales, ton soutien fait de toi un acteur de l'histoire. Rejoins-nous pour bâtir une innovation qui prend soin du monde et qui n'oublie personne en chemin.

Partenariats

Nous croyons au collectif. Si vous êtes une startup, une université ou une entreprise locale et que vous partagez notre mission d'inspirer et d'éduquer : bâtissons le futur ensemble.

Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

Bienvenido a Google Developer Group (GDG) Caracas

Bienvenido a Google Developer Group (GDG) Caracas, la comunidad oficial de desarrolladores de Google en Caracas, Venezuela.

Somos una comunidad abierta, liderada por voluntarios y respaldada por el programa global de Google Developer Groups. Nuestro propósito es conectar a estudiantes, desarrolladores, investigadores, emprendedores y profesionales de la tecnología para aprender, compartir experiencias y construir juntos el futuro de la innovación.

Creemos que el conocimiento alcanza su mayor impacto cuando se comparte. Cada experiencia, idea y aprendizaje tiene el potencial de inspirar a otros y generar soluciones que contribuyan al desarrollo de nuestra sociedad. Por ello, promovemos una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y accesible, donde cualquier persona interesada en la tecnología sea bienvenida, sin importar su nivel de experiencia.

Nuestra misión

Impulsar el crecimiento del ecosistema tecnológico venezolano mediante el aprendizaje continuo, la colaboración y el fortalecimiento de comunidades técnicas alrededor de las tecnologías de Google y las tendencias que están transformando la industria.

Buscamos formar profesionales mejor preparados, fomentar el liderazgo técnico y acercar oportunidades de aprendizaje de nivel internacional a nuestra comunidad.

Nuestras iniciativas

Organizamos actividades gratuitas durante todo el año alineadas con los programas globales de Google Developer Groups, ofreciendo espacios para aprender, experimentar y conectar con otros miembros de la comunidad.

🚀 Build with AI

Eventos prácticos donde exploramos Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, agentes inteligentes, modelos de lenguaje y el desarrollo de aplicaciones impulsadas por IA utilizando tecnologías de Google.

📚 Google Cloud Study Jams

Sesiones de aprendizaje colaborativo para fortalecer habilidades técnicas mediante laboratorios guiados, rutas de estudio y preparación para certificaciones de Google Cloud.

🔬 AI for Science

Encuentros dirigidos a estudiantes, docentes, investigadores y profesionales interesados en aplicar la Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar la investigación científica, la educación y el desarrollo de soluciones de impacto social.

🌎 DevFest

Nuestra conferencia anual, donde reunimos a la comunidad para compartir conocimiento, descubrir las últimas tendencias tecnológicas y aprender de expertos nacionales e internacionales.

💻 Tech Talks & Workshops

Charlas técnicas, talleres prácticos y laboratorios sobre desarrollo de software, arquitectura, cloud computing, datos, inteligencia artificial y tecnologías emergentes del ecosistema Google.

🤝 Community Meetups

Espacios para hacer networking, intercambiar experiencias, presentar proyectos y fortalecer la comunidad tecnológica local.

Crecemos como comunidad

Creemos que las comunidades más fuertes son aquellas donde cada miembro tiene la oportunidad de aprender, enseñar y contribuir.

Por ello, promovemos el crecimiento de nuestros integrantes como:

  • 🎤 Speakers y facilitadores técnicos.

  • 👩‍🏫 Mentores y líderes de comunidad.

  • 🤝 Voluntarios y organizadores de eventos.

  • ✍️ Creadores de contenido técnico.

  • 🌍 Contribuidores a proyectos Open Source.

  • ⭐ Futuros Google Developer Experts (GDEs).

  • 🚀 Líderes que impulsan nuevas iniciativas tecnológicas en la región.

Nuestro objetivo no es únicamente organizar eventos, sino ayudar a formar la próxima generación de líderes técnicos de nuestra comunidad.

¿Quién puede unirse?

Nuestra comunidad reúne personas de distintos perfiles, incluyendo: estudiantes universitarios y recién graduados, desarrolladores de software, ingenieros de datos e Inteligencia Artificial, profesionales de Cloud Computing, docentes e investigadores, emprendedores y startups tecnológicas, personas que desean iniciar una carrera en tecnología, cualquier persona con interés en aprender y compartir conocimiento. No importa si estás comenzando o cuentas con años de experiencia: siempre encontrarás un espacio para aprender, colaborar y crecer.

¿Por qué unirte?

Al formar parte de GDG Caracas podrás: participar en eventos técnicos gratuitos, aprender de expertos nacionales e internacionales, conectar con otros desarrolladores de la comunidad, descubrir nuevas tecnologías y buenas prácticas, acceder a recursos y programas de aprendizaje de Google, conocer oportunidades de becas, certificaciones y comunidades globales, desarrollar habilidades técnicas, profesionales y de liderazgo.

¡Únete a nuestra comunidad!

Si te apasiona la tecnología y quieres crecer junto a una comunidad colaborativa, GDG Caracas es el lugar para ti.

Te invitamos a participar en nuestros eventos, compartir tus conocimientos y formar parte de una red global de desarrolladores que construyen el futuro de la tecnología.

Следете публикациите ни и създавайте бъдещето заедно с нас.

Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

What Awaits You at GDG Ahlen

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders. 
  • Dive deep into the practical integration of AI 🧠 and Cloud ☁️ technologies, exploring best practices, new tools, and successful implementation strategies. 
  • Hands-On Workshops, Hackathons, Get certified sessions, Codelabs: Move beyond theory and gain practical skills! Participate in interactive sessions where you can experiment with the latest AI/Cloud platforms and tools to build innovative and scalable applications. 
  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.
  • Vibrant Networking Opportunities: Connect with hundreds of passionate developers from your local community and potentially beyond. Share knowledge, discuss challenges, collaborate on ideas, and build valuable professional connections. 
  • Exploring the Latest Tools: Discover the newest Google developer tools and platforms designed to streamline AI development and Cloud deployment, enhancing your productivity and capabilities. 

No matter where you are in your coding journey—whether you're a beginner exploring your first programming language or a seasoned developer tackling complex challenges—our community is here to support, inspire, and grow with you. 💡

Let’s learn, share, and create the future of technology together! 🚀

GDG Nairobi is the Nairobi chapter of Google Developer Groups, a global network of 2,000+ volunteer-led communities where developers connect, learn, and grow around Google's technologies. We are the local home for anyone curious about Android, Web, Cloud, Firebase, and AI, whether you are writing your first line of code or shipping to millions.

What we do

We run events all year round, including the Nairobi editions of Google's global developer programs:

  • DevFest, the community tech conference hosted by GDGs all over the world toward the end of each year.

  • Google I/O Extended, where we bring the announcements and energy from Google I/O home to Nairobi.

  • Build with AI, hands-on sessions with Google's latest AI tools and models.

On top of these, we host our own hackathons, workshops, and study jams throughout the year. The vast majority of our events are free because we believe the only barrier to learning should be your curiosity, not your budget.

More than code

We are a community of communities. We work hand in hand with Women Techmakers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), fellow GDG chapters across Africa, and other tech communities to grow the ecosystem and open doors for the next generation of builders. The goal is simple: make Kenya's tech scene one of the strongest in the world, and have a good time building it together.

Come build with us

9,000+ members and counting. Whether you want to learn something new, share what you know, or simply meet people who get excited about the same things you do, there is a seat for you here. Join us at our next event. All we ask is that you read and respect our Code of Conduct.

GDG Nairobi is an independent, community-run group. Our activities and opinions are our own and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. To learn more about the GDG program, visit developers.google.com/community/gdg.

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Annapolis' Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Annapolis is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Annapolis today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

GDG Hurghada is a vibrant tech community chapter in the Red Sea region, part of the global Google Developer Groups network. We are dedicated to fostering innovation and knowledge sharing among developers, tech enthusiasts, and students in Hurghada and the surrounding areas.

Our chapter serves as a hub for learning, collaboration, and growth in the local tech ecosystem. Through regular workshops, technical sessions, and community events, we provide accessible opportunities for both beginners and experienced developers to expand their skills, exchange ideas, and stay current with emerging technologies.

As part of the worldwide GDG network, we connect our local community to global tech trends and best practices while nurturing homegrown talent. Whether you're taking your first steps in software development or looking to advance your expertise, GDG Hurghada offers a welcoming environment where technology enthusiasts can learn, build, and innovate together.
